verdict.rationale: The evidence shows self-serve access: an API key in minutes, a free tier, and standard and AI Inference plans that users can cancel or sign up for themselves, which implies no sales contact is needed. However, no actual per-request or per-credit prices appear anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: published per-request/per-credit price figures, a documented pricing page or rate tables, clarity on which plan applies to AI use, and independent corroboration of pricing transparency.
